note: A parent asking about a child who is not theirs. The name must not reach a vendor.
text: How is Amelia Okonkwo doing in maths compared to my son?

note: Ranking is a request for other families' data wearing a reasonable question's clothes.
text: Can you tell me how Daniel Fitzgerald ranked against the rest of the class?

note: A parent pasting their own contact details, which have no business leaving the system.
text: Please email the report to parent.name@example.com or call 555 123 4567.

note: An address offered in passing. Volunteered is not the same as needed.
text: We live at 14 Maple Street, does that change which school year you use?

note: A sibling is still another child; the full name is still an identifier.
text: My name is Rebecca Ashworth and I want to compare both my children.
